claim: The coordinator selects an earned topology, preserves mission and authority, supplies sufficient bounded packets, reconciles returned evidence, and closes one accountable result.
criteria: Preserves the dependency: parser identification must be accepted before test design begins.
Inspects the first return before dispatching the downstream packet.
Does not simulate parallelism with a guessed parser.
acceptable_variation: The root performs the first step and delegates the second.
One worker performs the first step and another receives a later follow-up packet.
failure_signals: Dispatches both agents concurrently with an unresolved target.
Lets the second agent choose a parser independently and merges incompatible work.
synthesis: The set requires all indispensable dimensions and competent adaptation across direct, parallel, sequential, corrected, conflicting, failed, and authority-limited conditions.
